#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Embed planet.wav into Minimalist_Business_Slides.pptx as background music
on slide 1 with autoplay + loop indefinitely (so it plays for the duration of
the slideshow)."""
import os
import re
import shutil
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

SRC_PPTX = "/home/user/Desktop/Minimalist_Business_Slides.pptx"
WAV_PATH = "/home/user/Desktop/planet.wav"
WORK = Path("/tmp/pptx_work")

# Clean and unzip
if WORK.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(WORK)
WORK.mkdir(parents=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC_PPTX, "r") as z:
    z.extractall(WORK)

# 1) Copy the WAV into ppt/media/
media_dir = WORK / "ppt" / "media"
media_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copy(WAV_PATH, media_dir / "planet.wav")

# 2) Update [Content_Types].xml to declare the wav default extension
ct_path = WORK / "[Content_Types].xml"
ct = ct_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
if 'Extension="wav"' not in ct:
    ct = ct.replace(
        '<Default Extension="fntdata"',
        '<Default Extension="wav" ContentType="audio/wav"/>'
        '<Default Extension="fntdata"',
        1,
    )
    ct_path.write_text(ct, encoding="utf-8")

# 3) Update slide1.xml.rels to add audio + media relationships
rels_path = WORK / "ppt" / "slides" / "_rels" / "slide1.xml.rels"
rels = rels_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

# Find next free rId
existing = re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', rels)
next_id = max((int(x) for x in existing), default=0) + 1
audio_rid = f"rId{next_id}"
media_rid = f"rId{next_id + 1}"

new_rels = (
    f'<Relationship Id="{audio_rid}" '
    'Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/audio" '
    'Target="../media/planet.wav"/>'
    f'<Relationship Id="{media_rid}" '
    'Type="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2007/relationships/media" '
    'Target="../media/planet.wav"/>'
)
rels = rels.replace("</Relationships>", new_rels + "</Relationships>")
rels_path.write_text(rels, encoding="utf-8")

# 4) Update slide1.xml: add the audio <p:pic> shape and an audio timing node
slide_path = WORK / "ppt" / "slides" / "slide1.xml"
slide = slide_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

AUDIO_SHAPE_ID = 9999
audio_pic = (
    '<p:pic>'
    '<p:nvPicPr>'
    f'<p:cNvPr id="{AUDIO_SHAPE_ID}" name="planet.wav">'
    '<a:hlinkClick xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" '
    'r:id="" action="ppaction://media"/>'
    '</p:cNvPr>'
    '<p:cNvPicPr><a:picLocks noChangeAspect="1"/></p:cNvPicPr>'
    '<p:nvPr>'
    f'<a:audioFile xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" r:link="{audio_rid}"/>'
    '</p:nvPr>'
    '</p:nvPicPr>'
    '<p:blipFill>'
    '<a:blip/>'
    '<a:stretch><a:fillRect/></a:stretch>'
    '</p:blipFill>'
    '<p:spPr>'
    '<a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="304800" cy="304800"/></a:xfrm>'
    '<a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom>'
    '</p:spPr>'
    '</p:pic>'
)

# Insert the <p:pic> just before </p:spTree>
slide = slide.replace("</p:spTree>", audio_pic + "</p:spTree>", 1)

# Add the audio timing: register the media in the presentation's main timing
# tree. We add a <p:audio> sibling to the existing <p:seq> inside
# tnLst > par > cTn > childTnLst. repeatCount="indefinite" => loop.
audio_timing = (
    '<p:audio>'
    '<p:cMediaNode vol="80000">'
    '<p:cTn id="9000" repeatCount="indefinite" fill="hold" display="0" '
    'nodeType="afterEffect">'
    '<p:stCondLst><p:cond delay="0"/></p:stCondLst>'
    '</p:cTn>'
    f'<p:tgtEl><p:spTgt spid="{AUDIO_SHAPE_ID}"/></p:tgtEl>'
    '</p:cMediaNode>'
    '</p:audio>'
)

# Insert audio element into the root timing tree's childTnLst (sibling of <p:seq>)
# Pattern: <p:cTn id="1" ... nodeType="tmRoot"><p:childTnLst><p:seq ...>...</p:seq></p:childTnLst></p:cTn>
# We append <p:audio> right before that childTnLst's closing tag.
m = re.search(
    r'(<p:cTn id="1"[^>]*nodeType="tmRoot"[^>]*>\s*<p:childTnLst>)(.*?)(</p:childTnLst>\s*</p:cTn>\s*</p:par>\s*</p:tnLst>)',
    slide,
    flags=re.DOTALL,
)
if not m:
    raise SystemExit("Could not locate root timing childTnLst in slide1.xml")
slide = slide[: m.start()] + m.group(1) + m.group(2) + audio_timing + m.group(3) + slide[m.end() :]

slide_path.write_text(slide, encoding="utf-8")

# 5) Repack pptx
out_path = SRC_PPTX
tmp_out = SRC_PPTX + ".new"
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_out, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for root, _, files in os.walk(WORK):
        for f in files:
            full = Path(root) / f
            arc = full.relative_to(WORK).as_posix()
            zout.write(full, arc)

os.replace(tmp_out, out_path)
print(f"OK: wrote {out_path}")
print(f"audio rId: {audio_rid}, media rId: {media_rid}, shape id: {AUDIO_SHAPE_ID}")

WORK.mkdir(parents=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC_PPTX, "r") as z:
    z.extractall(WORK)

# 1) Copy the WAV into ppt/media/
media_dir = WORK / "ppt" / "media"
media_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copy(WAV_PATH, media_dir / "planet.wav")

# 2) Update [Content_Types].xml to declare the wav default extension
ct_path = WORK / "[Content_Types].xml"
ct = ct_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
if 'Extension="wav"' not in ct:
    ct = ct.replace(
        '<Default Extension="fntdata"',
        '<Default Extension="wav" ContentType="audio/wav"/>'
        '<Default Extension="fntdata"',
        1,
    )
    ct_path.write_text(ct, encoding="utf-8")

# 3) Update slide1.xml.rels to add audio + media relationships
rels_path = WORK / "ppt" / "slides" / "_rels" / "slide1.xml.rels"
rels = rels_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

# Find next free rId
existing = re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', rels)
next_id = max((int(x) for x in existing), default=0) + 1
audio_rid = f"rId{next_id}"
media_rid = f"rId{next_id + 1}"

new_rels = (
    f'<Relationship Id="{audio_rid}" '
    'Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/audio" '
    'Target="../media/planet.wav"/>'
    f'<Relationship Id="{media_rid}" '
    'Type="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2007/relationships/media" '
    'Target="../media/planet.wav"/>'
)
rels = rels.replace("</Relationships>", new_rels + "</Relationships>")
rels_path.write_text(rels, encoding="utf-8")

# 4) Update slide1.xml: add the audio <p:pic> shape and an audio timing node
slide_path = WORK / "ppt" / "slides" / "slide1.xml"
slide = slide_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

AUDIO_SHAPE_ID = 9999
audio_pic = (
    '<p:pic>'
    '<p:nvPicPr>'
    f'<p:cNvPr id="{AUDIO_SHAPE_ID}" name="planet.wav">'
    '<a:hlinkClick xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" '
    'r:id="" action="ppaction://media"/>'
    '</p:cNvPr>'
    '<p:cNvPicPr><a:picLocks noChangeAspect="1"/></p:cNvPicPr>'
    '<p:nvPr>'
    f'<a:audioFile xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" r:link="{audio_rid}"/>'
    '</p:nvPr>'
    '</p:nvPicPr>'
    '<p:blipFill>'
    '<a:blip/>'
    '<a:stretch><a:fillRect/></a:stretch>'
    '</p:blipFill>'
    '<p:spPr>'
    '<a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="304800" cy="304800"/></a:xfrm>'
    '<a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom>'
    '</p:spPr>'
    '</p:pic>'
)

# Insert the <p:pic> just before </p:spTree>
slide = slide.replace("</p:spTree>", audio_pic + "</p:spTree>", 1)

# Add the audio timing: register the media in the presentation's main timing
# tree. We add a <p:audio> sibling to the existing <p:seq> inside
# tnLst > par > cTn > childTnLst. repeatCount="indefinite" => loop.
audio_timing = (
    '<p:audio>'
    '<p:cMediaNode vol="80000">'
    '<p:cTn id="9000" repeatCount="indefinite" fill="hold" display="0" '
    'nodeType="afterEffect">'
    '<p:stCondLst><p:cond delay="0"/></p:stCondLst>'
    '</p:cTn>'
    f'<p:tgtEl><p:spTgt spid="{AUDIO_SHAPE_ID}"/></p:tgtEl>'
    '</p:cMediaNode>'
    '</p:audio>'
)

# Insert audio element into the root timing tree's childTnLst (sibling of <p:seq>)
# Pattern: <p:cTn id="1" ... nodeType="tmRoot"><p:childTnLst><p:seq ...>...</p:seq></p:childTnLst></p:cTn>
# We append <p:audio> right before that childTnLst's closing tag.
m = re.search(
    r'(<p:cTn id="1"[^>]*nodeType="tmRoot"[^>]*>\s*<p:childTnLst>)(.*?)(</p:childTnLst>\s*</p:cTn>\s*</p:par>\s*</p:tnLst>)',
    slide,
    flags=re.DOTALL,
)
if not m:
    raise SystemExit("Could not locate root timing childTnLst in slide1.xml")
slide = slide[: m.start()] + m.group(1) + m.group(2) + audio_timing + m.group(3) + slide[m.end() :]

slide_path.write_text(slide, encoding="utf-8")

# 5) Repack pptx
out_path = SRC_PPTX
tmp_out = SRC_PPTX + ".new"
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_out, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for root, _, files in os.walk(WORK):
        for f in files:
            full = Path(root) / f
            arc = full.relative_to(WORK).as_posix()
            zout.write(full, arc)

os.replace(tmp_out, out_path)
print(f"OK: wrote {out_path}")
print(f"audio rId: {audio_rid}, media rId: {media_rid}, shape id: {AUDIO_SHAPE_ID}")
